(i) the structure parameter can be interpreted as an indicator of the structuring level in the material, (ii) the structure parameter is a scalar quantity, (iii) the structure parameter varies continuously from zero to a large positive number, (iv) when the upper limit of the structure parameter is large, a thixotropic and viscoelastic fluid with an apparent yield stress is obtained, and (v) when the upper bound tends to infinity, a true yield stress fluid is obtained.
